checks: Actual production HTML executes ESM, mounts and binds; zero startup audio contexts, no legacy selector/stage dependency.
Real 16-second synth demo and real analyzer complete through UI.
Local WAV file picker invokes real decoder and automatic analysis; 2-second stereo 48kHz fixture decodes at native AudioContext rate, preserving existing processor behavior.
Uploaded reference is decoded/measured and used for real comparison.
Manual category/subgenre selection re-analyzes against the actual built-in profile, labelled as heuristic.
Real AudioContext source advances, pauses, seeks and cycles playback rate while celestial time advances and depth planes remain running. No listening claim.
Real region handles support keyboard increments and captured pointer drag; exact numeric inputs and ARIA values stay synchronized, without modifying source PCM.
IN/OUT region exports genuine 1-second stereo WAV with expected sample count.
Real OfflineAudioContext Master Fix + fast remeasurement publishes distinct B; original/fixed A–B selection works.
Manual output trim produces different real rendered WAV bytes; reset triggers another real render.
WAV A bytes remain exactly equal before/after Master Fix and adjustments. WAV and MP3 conversion download real files; MP3 decodes back to stereo of expected duration; text report downloads.

Both viewports: one opaque matte precision plane, no individual card halos; enabled controls meet measured 4.5:1 text and 3:1 boundary contrast. Large-viewport output actions fit without scrolling. Not a full WCAG certification.

Eight independent scene/atmosphere layers advance naturally at BOTH target sizes; five-second RAF/performance samples satisfy predeclared headless budget. Real limits dialog enters/exits with intermediate opacity, restores focus, closes by Escape and does not trigger playback. No filter/backdrop blur.
Real analysis results, Master Fix/manual processing and opened adjustment controls activate host surface transitions; playback ticks do not retrigger these animations.

BOTH target viewports: all eight environmental animations/transforms really stop under reduced motion, and native panel transitions are disabled. Captures have no horizontal overflow, clipped controls or broken images.
Turning reduced motion back off resumes all depth layers without remounting or resetting audio.
Cropping B preserves exact floor/ceil sample-boundary behavior at its rendered sample rate; A export remains byte-identical.
Applying crop to A re-analyzes the 1-second working buffer; original filesystem fixture remains unchanged.
Invalid audio reports a genuine decoder failure and preserves the current buffer. Its console error is expected and recorded.
